note: Generated by tools/switch-census.mjs. `verdict` is written by hand: what a mod can do about this dispatch. `kind` is SWITCH, IF_CHAIN (an if/else chain of >= threshold arms over one discriminant) or ARRAY_LOOKUP (a module-level const array of >= threshold elements, indexed dynamically) - three syntactic shapes that are equally closed to a mod. A new or resized row arrives as UNADJUDICATED.

REACHABLE - the arm behind registry:tval. These five obj-tval.c bodies are no longer the dispatch: each is core's registered handler inside seedTval(...), and the exported predicate is one lookup. A mod reaches the WHOLE arm through classes.handlerFor(name) and wraps it, so the switch inside is core's own data rather than a closed door. The census counts a switch wherever it lives, which is why these rows stay - kept verbatim on purpose, because the 1,224 recorded answers are what proves the conversion changed nothing.
